ModMetaData.name: SQUISHY Ranged
ModMetaData.author: SQUISHY
ModMetaData.description: A standalone recoil system for ranged weapons and turrets. Each shot makes handheld guns kick back and rise, while the body leans, compresses, and recoils along with it. Turrets kick back along the barrel; a pawn manning one can receive body recoil. Optional head movement and residual recoil add extra weight and character, with three distinct body-motion styles to choose from. Weapons are held further away from the body for a more natural stance. Handheld muzzle flashes remain attached to the weapon, and burst turret flashes can follow turret recoil when Muzzle Flash is loaded. Integrated tabs let you access the Muzzle Flash Editor and customize Show Me Your Hands' per-weapon hand settings, including individual hand sizes. All features are managed through a dedicated, spacious options window with a docked layout.
